resources.string: Dish runs on coffee and goodwill.
Hosting. dish.tinkernorth.com, tinkernorth.com, and every signed-installer mirror. AWS isn\'t free, even at our traffic scale.
Code-signing certificates. Windows SmartScreen only plays nice because we pay for an EV certificate every year. The same goes for the Apple Developer Program account for the upcoming macOS client.
Google Play developer fee. A one-time $25 fee plus the time required to keep the Play listing compliant with every new policy round.
Time. Honest answer: most of it. Dish is a nights-and-weekends project. Donations let me say \"yes\" to working on it instead of taking on extra consulting.
Thank you. Every dollar, every star, every shared link. They all add up. Emir
